ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Regard the constraints as half-planes on the plane, whose boundary lines are respectively: x-y+1=0, y+1=0, x+y+1=0. Find the pairwise intersections: from x-y+1=0 and x+y+1=0 obtain the point (-1,0); from x-y+1=0 and y+1=0 obtain the point (-2,-1); from y+1=0 and x+y+1=0 obtain the point (0,-1). These three points all satisfy the constraints and are the vertices of the feasible region. The maximum value of the linear objective function 2x-y on this bounded polygonal region occurs at a vertex. Substitute respectively: at (-1,0), 2x-y=-2; at (-2,-1), 2x-y=-4+1=-3; at (0,-1), 2x-y=0+1=1. Therefore the maximum value is 1.
